method: Every WebFetch attempt in this session failed with DNS errors (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for digi24.ro, financiarul.ro, insse.ro, paylab.com and en.wikipedia.org), so no page could be read. EVERY figure below was seen ONLY in a WebSearch result summary and is marked seenIn 'search-snippet'. Figures the summary gave only as 'about / around / roughly' were dropped. Where the summary did not make clear which result URL carried a figure, the note says so. A reviewer should open each URL before using a figure.

evidence.claim: Aumovio (the former Continental automotive business) has four R&D centres in Romania (Brașov, Iași, Sibiu, Timișoara) and two production sites. About 13,000 employees, more than half of them engineers and IT specialists in the R&D centres (undated company profile).

Aumovio is cutting 641 jobs across Iași, Sibiu and Timișoara, including 236 in the Timișoara R&D department (digital and electronics engineering), with most measures in place by end-2026. This is evidence that the activity exists and of a 2025–26 contraction. Attribution between wall-street.ro and economedia.ro is unclear.
Continental worked with over 5,700 engineers and IT specialists in R&D in Romania (2018). In 2022 it employed 17,500 in Romania, over a third of them engineers and computer scientists.
Continental invested over USD 37 million to expand its Romanian R&D centre.

Activity: 'activități de servicii în tehnologia informației (inclusiv activități de servicii informatice)' (CAEN division 62 group), so this is an industry average, not an occupation. Automotive software activity is clearly real (Aumovio/Continental R&D in Timișoara, Iași, Sibiu, Brașov). Elektrobit, Bosch Cluj and Hella/Forvia evidence was not reached.

countries.notes: HIGH INFLATION: TRY figures from different months of 2025 and 2026 are not comparable, and none of the job-board pages gave the month of its data. Most Turkish salary aggregates quote NET monthly pay, but none of the summaries confirmed it, so every TRY survey figure is 'net or gross unverified'. The official TÜİK 2023 section-J figure is gross annual but two years and ~100%+ cumulative inflation old. Automotive software evidence is real but thin and partly dated (Ford Otosan 2015, AVL Istanbul, Bosch Türkiye/Togg). No current TOGG software headcount was found.

evidence.claim: Valeo Cairo: tech hub for automotive software, grown into an innovation hub of more than 2,500 software engineers, contributing roughly half of the Group's global software production (Valeo).
Valeo page dated July 2026: 2,200 Egyptian engineers at Smart Village developing R&D software for automotive. Headcounts conflict across Valeo pages (1,600 in 2018; 2,200; 2,500; 3,000).
Valeo celebrated 20 years in Egypt and launched an AI Development Centre in Cairo (50+ engineers at opening, growing to 100+). The talent pool is described as 3,000 engineers.

countries.notes: Valeo Cairo is unambiguously a large automotive software centre, so the country qualifies. Salary data are weak: the official CAPMAS figure is 2023 (pre-devaluation), and the embedded figures are PayScale with obvious data-quality flags. Wuzzuf salary data and Siemens EDA Egypt were not reached. lifeindexed.com figures (EGP 848,600/yr software engineer) were seen but EXCLUDED as machine-generated estimates. The EGP was floated in March 2024 (roughly halving its USD value), so any figure that does not state 2024-H2 or later data should be treated as stale.
